subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: will you go to school today the mother said to her son no mother our classes are suspended then go to market and bring some vegetables let me be ready and give me money Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Punctuation and capitalization: "Will you go to school today?" the mother said to her son. "No mother, our classes are suspended." "Then go to market and bring some vegetables." "Let me be ready and give me money." ●Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
